role.title: Role of this machine
role.description: Lucania links two machines: the server runs the models, the receiver uses them.
role.label: Role of this machine

tower.title: This machine is used as a server
tower.text: It runs the models and makes them available to another machine.

laptop.title: This machine is used as a receiver
laptop.text: This machine keeps its local models. The server's models are added to the chat's model picker, with a server icon.

link.title: Connect to the server
link.description: Paste the code shown on the server machine, pick the network, then connect. The Next button turns on once the link has been tested successfully.
link.pending: No link yet: connect this machine to the server.

tower.title: Remote shutdown of this server
tower.description: You can let the other machine shut this server down from Lucania. This is optional: answer No to enable nothing.
tower.note: At the end of the wizard you will be given a code: the other machine needs it to connect.

laptop.title: Remote shutdown of the server
laptop.description: Lucania asks the server how to shut it down remotely, then saves it for you.

recap.title: Summary
recap.description: Here is the state of the connection between your machines.

server.label: Server mode
server.codeHidden: The full code is no longer shown. To get a new one, delete the server and set it up again.
